prompt: Your quiz score is $f(q) = 4q$ points, and the quiz has at most $10$ questions ($q$ can be $0$ to $10$). What is the LARGEST output in the range?
hint: Range = the set of possible OUTPUTS. The biggest output comes from the biggest input.

hints.text: Range = the set of possible OUTPUTS. The biggest output comes from the biggest input.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Check the ends: $q = 0$ gives $0$ points and $q = 10$ gives $40$ points. The range is everything the machine CAN output between those.
The biggest allowed input is $q = 10$. Compute $f(10)$.

explanation: The rule multiplies by $4$, so bigger inputs give bigger outputs.

alternativeExplanations.title: List the outputs
steps: The outputs are $0, 4, 8, 12, \ldots$ climbing by $4$ each time.
They stop when the questions run out at $q = 10$: the last one is $40$.
